warden_frame.name: Warden-frame
warden_frame.notes: a rebuilt Lumen drone, joined only by the quest that reboots a Warden: mechanical, o2_use 0, ranged x1.5, ion damage x3

murrow.name: Murrow
murrow.notes: mole-folk diggers, the large rig over the normal 2x2 body: hp x1.2, speed x0.9, mining_mult 1.5 (rock damage when manning a mining tool or cutting)

siltborn.name: Siltborn
siltborn.notes: gas-giant floaters, the floating rig, no sidearm: o2_use 0.5, fire damage x2, low_pressure_heal 1 hp/s in a room under 50% air

corvin.name: Corvin
corvin.notes: crow-like wreck traders: haggler (station prices -10%), loot_bonus (+1 roll on wreck, salvage and loot tables)

brine.name: Brine
brine.notes: crab-shelled dockworkers, the large rig over the normal 2x2 body: melee and ranged damage taken x0.7, restock x1.5, speed x0.85, no_suit

echo.name: Echo
echo.notes: a polite shimmering mimic: mimic (copies the best non-body trait of another crew member in the same room, while there)

ferro.name: Ferro
ferro.notes: living ferrofluid: ion damage x0 (immune), hull_mend 0.5 (idle, mends the walls beside them), station.pull_bonus +1 (the salvage intake they man pulls 1 cell further)
